probes.check: am_probe_flecs_jobs(): the world uses task threads, and a frame (ecs_progress) submits its worker stages through the jobs interface.

seeded_violation.description: Leave flecs's default task functions, which start OS threads, in the OS API.

adaptation_notes: task_new_ submits a worker stage as a job and task_join_ waits for it: flecs makes and joins its worker tasks each frame, after setup glue's ecs_set_task_threads.

A flecs worker task blocks until the main thread releases it, which the jobs contract's guidance warns against; it is safe only while every stage's task has a worker to itself, which setup glue keeps by asking for no more stages than the jobs interface has workers.
